Overview Link: Private Residence Dormans Park is a 743 m² natural stone package for a country house on the Surrey–Sussex border near East Grinstead. The work is ongoing in 2026 and Marla Stone is currently on site. Ten stones are used across the house: Crema Marfil Marble, Olive Maron Marble, Dover White Marble, Statuario Marble, Arabescato Marble, Calacatta Michelangelo Marble, Bianco Carrara CD Marble, Taj Mahal Quartzite, Light Beige Vein Cut Travertine and Jura Beige Limestone. The scope runs from a curved marble staircase and the hall and living room floors to fireplaces, kitchen surfaces, bathrooms, WCs, bespoke basins and a basement suite with a bar and an indoor pool, delivered with templating, shop drawings and on-site stone installation supervision.

Featured Stonework Text: The staircase is the centrepiece: curved treads and risers templated on site and drawn piece by piece before cutting, so each tread follows the sweep of the stair. The principal bathroom is clad at full height in Dover White marble, and the other bathrooms pair large-format veined marble wall slabs with herringbone marble floors, solid bath surrounds, recessed niches and vanity tops cut from the same blocks so the veining reads across walls and joinery. In the basement, the pool hall is lined with bookmatched Dover White marble panels and marble-clad columns, with a stone pool surround and a bar counter finished with a moulded edge profile. Every room was issued as shop drawings first, so vein direction, joint lines and edge details were agreed on paper before any slab was cut.
